title: femto divergence registry file
description: Every file in tests/divergences/ except this one is a JSON array of entries. A difference between a 2.1.1 reference and femto passes only if at least one entry matches it. Patterns: a plain string matches exactly (values compare with the harness color tolerance), "*" matches anything, and "/regex/flags" is a JavaScript regular expression (flags i, m, s, u). tests/README.md documents matching in full.

module.description: Module id (forms/basics), or tokens, rig, entries.

selector.description: style: CSS selector the differing element must match in the TEST document ("*" for any). token and token-raw: optional selector the anchor element must match.

token.description: Token kinds: custom property name or /regex/.

pseudo.description: style only: "" for the element itself, "::before", "::after", "::marker", "::placeholder", "::file-selector-button", "::backdrop", "*" or /regex/. Omitted means any.

property.description: style: longhand name; token: the probe property the token was resolved through. Exact, "*" or /regex/.

reference.description: Value on the 2.1.1 side: exact, "*" or /regex/.

femto.description: Value on the femto side: exact, "*" or /regex/.

check.description: skipped-check: the check name (media:dark, media:light, pseudo:::backdrop, ...), exact or /regex/.

where.description: Optional filters; every listed key must match the comparison cell.

presets.description: Preset names from tests/variants.json (default, classless, theme-jade, option-no-transitions, ...).

variants.description: Matches the preset name, the entry, the page variant label (plain, class=modal-is-open) or the comparison kind (direct, self, hybrid, control).
